newsitem.title: GHANA: Consumer and brewery shares lead Ghana bourse rise.
newsitem.headline: Consumer and brewery shares lead Ghana bourse rise.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange share index edged higher on Friday with blue-chip Unilever leading gains in moderately active trade.
The GSE all-share index rose 0.84 points to 363.32 points from 362.48.
Unilever rose 10 cedis to 800 cedis, after a stable few weeks, with Guiness Ghana Ltd, up four to 354, and Pioneer Tobacco Co up four to 150.
Many other share prices retained their values at the week's close, while shares in Fan Milk, the only loser, fell by five cedis to 390 cedis.
A total of 31,200 shares changed hands. Bids outpaced offers by 3,866,200 to 549,200.
